title: Twelve-bar blues in C major (simplified)
trains: The twelve-bar blues with three-note chords held a whole bar: four bars of I, two of IV, two of I, then V, IV, I, I. The thumb keeps the keynote from I to IV and back; finger 5 keeps the fifth from I to V. Count the bars. A simpler version of the next lesson.
